articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced that new single-story homes are coming soon to Grand Oaks of Callaway, a new community from the Company's Century Complete brand, with a Grand Opening event set for Saturday, September 26. A virtual insider preview event will also be held on Monday, September 14. Featuring modern and affordable new homes from the upper $200s in a location less than five miles from Panama City, Grand Oaks of Callaway combines suburban ease with coastal charm. articles.title: Affordable, Modern New Homes Coming Soon to Callaway, FL, Near Panama City from Century Complete

articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—will host a Grand Opening celebration at Mirabella, its newest West Houston community, on Saturday, September 12 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. The tailgate-themed event in Brookshire will welcome visitors for burgers, yard games and face painting as they tour two fully furnished new model homes and explore available homes. New homes at the Italian-inspired community are now selling from the low $200s across two floor plan collections. Learn more, explore available homes and RSVP for the Grand Opening at www.CenturyCommunities.com/MirabellaGO .
